decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A1035-WMH-020, A1035-WMH-100, A1035-WMH-101, A1035-WMH-110, A1035-WMH-111, A1035-WMH-130, A1035-WMH-200, A1035-WMH-201, A1035-WMH-202, A1035-WMH-210 Rev A, A1035-WMH-211 Rev A, A1035-WMH-230, PL-A1035-WMH-000, 00-M-GF-200-01 Rev P2, Sterilwave Product Presentation by Eurotec Environmental, Noise Impact Assessment Rev 0 dated 28 November 2018 by F1 Acoustics Company Ltd.,  received: 03/12/2018. A1035-WMH-001 Rev C received: 18/02/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The operation of the proposed waste processing equipment shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Noise Impact Assessment Rev 0 dated 28 November 2018 by F1 Acoustics Company Ltd.

Condition : 4 - The proposed waste processing equipment shall not be operated outside of the hours of 06:00 to 22:00 Mondays to Saturdays, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until such time as a scheme to dispose of surface water has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The scheme shall be based on an assessment of the hydrological and hydrogeological context of the development. All waste storage areas must drain to foul sewer and only clean uncontaminated surface water should drain to surface water drains. The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details before the development is completed. The scheme shall also include details of how the scheme shall be maintained and managed after completion.
description: Installation of zero emissions waste disposal plant within an existing waste disposal building including the installation of two stainless steel flues
